name: NeRF Volume Rendering
aliases: NeRF Volume Rendering and Depth Estimation
definition: A technique to render novel viewpoint images from an invisible MLP by sampling points along rays and accumulating density and color values.
summary: NeRF Volume Rendering synthesizes photorealistic novel views by using a neural network to estimate volume density and color along camera rays, distinguishing itself by querying a continuous implicit field rather than interpolating from a discrete voxel grid.
